description: Test utility functions for Telegram bot media handling, including mocks, spies, and bot handler creation.

methods.name: createFetchMockHandle
methods.description: Creates a mock handle for fetch with restore capability.

methods.name: createBotHandler
methods.description: Creates a Telegram bot handler with default options.

methods.name: createBotHandlerWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a Telegram bot handler with specified options.

methods.name: mockTelegramFileDownload
methods.description: Mocks downloading a Telegram file with specified content type and bytes.

methods.name: mockTelegramPngDownload
methods.description: Mocks downloading a PNG image from Telegram.

methods.name: watchTelegramFetch
methods.description: Returns a fetch mock handle for observing fetch calls.

methods.name: loadTelegramBotHarness
methods.description: Initializes the test harness for the Telegram bot.
